info.title: Factory Control Plane API
info.description: REST surface: web <-> control plane. Domain terms follow CONTEXT.md; the full contract is in .scratch/distributed-software-factory/spec.md.

get.summary: Liveness probe. Never touches Postgres.
Readiness probe. Confirms Postgres is reachable.

post.summary: Writes one row to Postgres using a client-generated id.

get.summary: Reads one row back from Postgres.
Redirects to GitHub's OAuth authorize screen.
Exchanges a GitHub OAuth code for a session. Sets the session cookie.

schema.description: One-time authorization code GitHub redirected back with.

parameters.description: One-time authorization code GitHub redirected back with.
parameters.name: code

post.summary: Local password login for the break-glass account, on its own route — never GitHub.
Revokes the current session.

get.summary: Projects the caller is a member of. Never a list of every Project (spec: "tidak bisa melihat apa pun di luar itu").

post.summary: Creates a Project. Org `owner` only.

get.summary: One Project. 403 (not a member) beats 404 for an id that does exist; 404 only for an id that genuinely doesn't.

403.description: Not a member. Body names the Project and the reason; an org owner's body also names the self-add escape hatch.

patch.summary: Admin settings write. Configures the User→ServiceAccount fallback, the one Project notification channel webhook, or the automation kill switch (`automationEnabled` — admin-only, audited under its own action kind). The webhook URL is never returned.

post.summary: Adds (or changes the role of) a Project member. Project `admin` only.
The org owner escape hatch this issue's acceptance criteria name: an owner denied a Project adds themselves as admin. Always audited.
Creates a Group. Any Project member.
Adds a Group member. Domain-layer invariant, not UI: the target must already be a member of the Group's Project.

400.description: Target is not a member of the Group's Project.

post.summary: Triggers a Pipeline over a ref. Reads the definition (and every prompt file it references) from that ref, validates, and — if valid — materializes the Run and its initial Graph in one transaction. Project `member`.

id.description: Client-generated Run id; a repeat of the same id is rejected by the primary key.

201.description: Created. `stepRuns` holds the Steps materialized up front — see the Run's `definition` for the rest of the Graph's shape.

400.description: Rejected before any row was written: an unknown ref, a missing definition or prompt file, a definition that fails validation, the combined size over the inline-storage limit, an unknown Step repo:, or a repeated Run id.

get.summary: Runs for a Project, newest first. Keyset pagination on id — no total count. `inFlight=true` filters ended_at IS NULL; `outcome=` filters a final verdict; the two are never combined.
One Run: its own copy of the definition and prompt files, plus its Graph so far.

ETag.description: Opaque version for conditional Graph polling.

304.description: Not modified. The response has no body.

post.summary: Records cancel_requested_at immediately as operator intent. StepRun cancellation follows through the Runner heartbeat channel; repeating the request is idempotent. Project member.
Creates a new manual Run from a selected StepRun. The old Run and its Artifacts remain intact; the new Run carries parent_run_id.

400.description: Invalid rewind or duplicate new Run id.

get.summary: Returns four query-derived reopen numbers for the grilling screen: draft revisions, human edits, recorded decisions, and open Questions.

post.summary: Requests cancellation of a Run by id. Project membership is resolved from the Run.
Creates a child Run by parent id. The old Run and its Artifacts remain intact.

400.description: Invalid rewind or duplicate new Run id.

post.summary: Creates a ServiceAccount for a Project — the Principal that owns the Project's secrets (spec: "kunci Project menempel ke ServiceAccount, bukan ke Project"). Project admin only.

get.summary: Lists a Project's ServiceAccounts. Project member (names are not credentials).

post.summary: Stores (or re-stores) a Project secret, encrypted at rest under the current master key version. Write-only: the value is never returned and never decryptable through this surface. Project admin only.

patch.summary: Replaces a secret's value, re-encrypted under the current master key version. Write-only, like store. Project admin only. The secret id travels in the body, never the URL (spec: "tidak ada credential di path maupun query string").

delete.summary: Deletes a secret. Project admin only, audited. The secret id travels in the body, never the URL.

get.summary: Lists a Project's secrets — names and key versions only, never values. The value surface is write-only by design (AC: "secrets are NOT readable back by anyone").

post.summary: Re-encrypts every secret of the Project under the current master key version. Incremental and interruptible: rows not yet rewritten still decrypt (their old version stays in the key file), and running Runs are never disturbed. Project admin only, audited.

put.summary: Replaces the Project's egress allowlist wholesale — the only egress the sandbox is allowed, everything else is denied. Every change is recorded in the audit log (AC: "allowlist per Project masuk daftar audit"). Project admin only.

post.summary: Exchanges a single-use join token for a runner id + bearer secret. The Runner writes both to a file on disk — never a hostname or IP carries identity (spec).

401.description: Token invalid, unknown, or already used.

post.summary: Long-polls for up to a server-randomized 20-30s (spec). 200 with `step_run: null` when the hold elapses with nothing to claim — that is not an error. 426 outside the supported protocol range; 503 + Retry-After above the hanging-connection cap.

The only command channel. Always 200, even outside the supported protocol range (spec) — a healthy-but-permanently-idle Runner still needs somewhere to be seen by an operator. `unknown_leases` and `cancel` are always disjoint lists with different meanings.
Full capabilities report, sent when the Runner's locally-computed caps_hash no longer matches what the last heartbeat reply confirmed (`caps_stale`).
CLI-local write of desired_state='draining' — the Runner asking to stop taking new work while finishing what it holds. See /runners/{id}/drain for the operator/UI path into the same column.
Mints presigned PUT grants for this turn's artifacts/session — replaces the previous grant list rather than adding to it (spec).
Records log chunk metadata, batch. Dedup at the primary key (step_run_id, attempt, seq), not in application code.
The commit point of a turn that ends by asking a human. Moves the StepRun to awaiting-human without a lease.

The commit point of a turn that ends succeeded/failed. Idempotent on lease_token itself: the same token replays the recorded outcome at 200; a stale one (superseded by a sweep, or the row was cancelled) is 409 and the Runner is fenced.

409.description: Lease no longer valid — cancelled, or superseded by another claim.

post.summary: Mints a single-use Runner join token. Org owner only. The raw token is returned exactly once — only its hash is ever stored.
Sets operator-written policy: slots and tags (spec: "kebijakan ditulis operator"). Org owner only.
Operator/UI write of desired_state='draining' — the same column the Runner's own /runners/me/drain writes (spec: "ditulis CLI lokal maupun tombol UI"). Org owner only.
Instant fencing, not killing (spec, verbatim): the Runner's secret stops authenticating from this point on, regardless of whether its process is still alive. Org owner only.
Authoritative cancel: the row goes `cancelled` immediately (spec: "Cancel otoritatif di control plane"). A /result already in flight for this StepRun is answered 409. Project member.

400.description: Already ended with a different outcome.

get.summary: Live-tail and archive in one endpoint. Long-polls up to 30s from `offset` and returns any chunks with seq >= offset as a list of 5-minute presigned GETs (never bytes). Archive is the same call with offset=0. Returns immediately, empty, once the StepRun has ended. Project member.

200.description: Ok. `ended: true` means nothing more can arrive — stop polling. One tab = one hanging connection; no SSE, no WebSocket.

get.summary: Lists immutable artifact history for a Run. `key=prd` is the grilling draft history, ordered by turn, with human-authored rows marked.

Lists one StepRun's artifacts — metadata only, no bytes. The optional `key` filter is the per-key history query (spec: 'riwayat adalah kueri per key diurutkan menurut turn'): each turn is its own StepRun, so walking turns with ?key=prd yields the history. Project member.
One artifact: metadata plus a 5-minute presigned GET, minted only after the Project-membership check. The browser fetches the bytes straight from Garage. Project member.

One StepRun's cost with the per-attempt breakdown (issue 12, AC6). A retried StepRun has one row per attempt; the cumulative total is a plain sum. An attempt whose agent reported no usage is `supported: false` — shown as 'tidak didukung', never estimated. Project member.

One Run's cost (issue 12, AC8). While the Run is in flight (`runEnded: false`) this is the running cost — the sum of completed attempts so far — which the run-detail screen (the one with the cancel button) shows live. Project member.

The Project's cost across every Run (issue 12, AC2/AC9). Explicitly a *lower bound*, never a total: agents that reported no usage and Runs still in flight contribute nothing, and the price table is pinned to what was already written. Broken down by the credential principal each Run used, so shared-credential usage is visible. Project member.
The 'Menunggu saya' list: every open Question whose audience Group contains the caller, oldest first (issue 19's badge is this same query). Cancelled runs vanish automatically.
One Question's latest state — the read a race-losing client uses to refresh.

403.description: Not a member of the Question's Group.

post.summary: Mints the browser PUT for an edit-artifact answer. Only a member of the Question's Group may mint it; the existing Question CAS remains the single turn owner.

403.description: Not a member of the Question's Group.

post.summary: Records a human's answer, compare-and-set: first answer wins. `approved: false` is data — it is sent back to the agent as the next turn's prompt, and only a Step's `onReject: fail` fails the StepRun. Losing the race is 409 carrying the latest state plus your own typed answer, never discarded.

403.description: Not a member of the Question's Group.

409.description: Race lost: the Question was already answered, or its StepRun moved on. Body carries the latest state plus your typed answer.

post.summary: The GitHub App webhook. Verifies the `x-hub-signature-256` HMAC, then drops the raw event into the dedup table (layer 1: `X-GitHub-Delivery` for 24h) and answers 202 — every mapping to Runs happens on the sweep, out of GitHub's request path. A redelivered delivery id is ack'ed and dropped. The body is the raw GitHub webhook payload; it is deliberately NOT schema'd here because the HMAC must be verified over the exact bytes — the handler reads the raw body itself.

202.description: Accepted (or a duplicate delivery, which is dropped).

400.description: Missing delivery id or unparseable body.

401.description: Bad HMAC signature — the payload was not signed by the configured webhook secret.

get.summary: Cron fires that were skipped because a Run was already active for the same (Pipeline, ref) — the visible half of "skip saat tumpang tindih". Keyset on id DESC, newest first, no total count.
